image_description: A close-up shot of a small, bi-colored (black and white/grey) hamster inside a cage environment. The hamster is positioned on the right side, next to a blue plastic exercise wheel. In the foreground left, there is a white square bowl filled with seeds and nuts. Behind the bowl is a large orange spherical object (likely a toy or ball). The background shows blurred cage bars and colorful elements.

The ear on the visible side is rounded and proportionally large relative to the head size, typical for a hamster.
